page.layout: Two printed columns on one page, left and right. The left column holds the page's main text, with bracketed tree diagrams for the baths and pools and then the regional heading. The right column is cut off at the bottom. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. A small marginal note at the far left, low on the page.; One page of text in the right part of the scan, with a column of marginal notes on its left edge (brace-linked lists), the main text in one column at right, and a fragment of a line at the lower left below the blanked area. Marginal notes in the right margin (line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50).

page.notes: The right column is cut off below its first lines and the lower left lines are cut at the bottom edge; the last words are incomplete. The left-margin note is in very small type and is read with doubt. The heading "REGI" is cut at the column edge and is read as printed. Some diagram labels are faint and read with doubt. Marginal notes on the left (Arcus, Sepulcra, Horrea, Piscina, Domus, Insulae, Regio) are brace-linked lists with Roman numerals and abbreviations, transcribed as far as legible. The left margin notes at the top are partly cut. Note numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 are line numbers. Some text in the upper right notes is only partly legible. The first line of the main text is a fragment and is left as printed.
